result.topic_en: A list of hidden summations of series of squared reciprocals of hyperbolic cosines and sines at multiples of π, expressed in terms of the lemniscate constant ϖ, followed by algebraic scratch calculations with lemniscatic sine/cosine quantities s, c, s', c'.
result.transcription:
Math 25
Variae Summationes serierum absconditae. [-47c/-] [-31-] (31)
1° $\left(\frac{2}{e^{\pi}+e^{-\pi}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{2}{e^{2\pi}+e^{-2\pi}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{2}{e^{3\pi}+e^{-3\pi}}\right)^2+$ etc. $=\frac{1}{2}\frac{\varpi\varpi}{\pi\pi}+\frac{1}{2\pi}-\frac{1}{2}$
2° $\left(\frac{2}{e^{\frac12\pi}-e^{-\frac12\pi}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{2}{e^{\frac32\pi}-e^{-\frac32\pi}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{2}{e^{\frac52\pi}-e^{-\frac52\pi}}\right)^2+$ etc. $=\frac{1}{2}\frac{\varpi\varpi}{\pi\pi}-\frac{1}{2\pi}$
3) $\left(\frac{2}{e^{\pi}-e^{-\pi}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{2}{e^{2\pi}-e^{-2\pi}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{2}{e^{3\pi}-e^{-3\pi}}\right)^2+$ etc $=\frac{1}{6}-\frac{1}{2\pi}$
4) $\left(\frac{2}{e^{\frac12\pi}+e^{-\frac12\pi}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{2}{e^{\frac32\pi}+e^{-\frac32\pi}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{2}{e^{\frac52\pi}+e^{-\frac52\pi}}\right)^2+$ etc. $=\frac{1}{2\pi}$
5) $\frac{2}{e^{\frac12\pi}+e^{-\frac12\pi}}+\frac{2}{e^{\frac32\pi}+e^{-\frac32\pi}}+$ etc. $=\frac{1}{2}\frac{\varpi}{\pi}$
